verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents streaming workflow step updates or model tokens to a frontend while a run executes. The closest items describe MCP event emit/subscribe, which starts workflow runs rather than streaming their progress, and bundling workflows into React/Next.js apps. Neither delivers live progress streaming, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I stream live progress — step updates or model tokens — from a running workflow into my frontend as it executes
